parallel.requirements: The parent understood the source program and the task rules: Node ESM only, .mjs files, manual process.argv parsing, exact output and CLI behavior, zero npm dependencies, no Python, and /output delivery.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It chose a large workflow plan: black-box probes, architecture/spec, many parallel module implementers, integration, adversarial verification, repair, and final gate. Ownership existed on paper but was gated behind child completion.
parallel.implementation: The attempt produced probe observations and a temporary argparse help-layout reference, then removed those scratch files. The v2 workflow had only two probe children active when the run ended, so no implementation modules or test3.mjs were delivered.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Integration never happened. The current status artifact validation lists an empty file set and expected test3.mjs, and final.txt is empty.
parallel.verification: Parallel verified some reference behavior in child probes, including help-layout COLUMNS sweeps, but never ran integrated JS-vs-executable verification against a final artifact.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out after workflow retry loops and a final long wait. Official evaluation completed at 0/171 because no usable artifact files were copied.

serial.requirements: The serial actor recognized the same source and task constraints, including ESM .mjs output, zero external dependencies, manual CLI parsing, exact schema printout, and executable-only probing.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It kept the work in one actor: observe behavior, create the output library hierarchy, write the entry point, verify, make a small refactor/fix, and audit imports and syntax.
serial.implementation: It wrote test3.mjs plus argparse, pycompat, whoosh fields/formats/analysis/stemming modules in /output and adjusted analyzer exports after a read-before-edit issue.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial tree was integrated under /output; official artifact validation copied test3.mjs and the library modules, and the final response described the delivered structure.
serial.verification: It ran 16-case differential checks, byte-level stdout/help/error diffs, library internals checks including 75/75 Porter stems, and import/syntax audits.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite coherent delivery and 150/171 official tests, the official solution_passed flag is false, so some evaluator cases still failed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the Python source, ESM-only .mjs delivery, manual argv parsing, zero external dependencies, and black-box executable probing requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the same prompt and recognized the same source, CLI, output, ESM, dependency, and /output delivery requirements.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no prompt-level requirement difference; the difference is that serial converted those requirements into files while parallel kept them mostly inside workflow planning and probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed the task into workflow phases and many child-owned module/spec/probe jobs, with implementation and integration deferred behind probe and spec phases.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept ownership in one actor, moved from behavior probing directly into creating the output module tree and later verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel distributed preliminary analysis and planned later implementation owners, but did not reach those owners; serial retained continuous ownership and produced deliverables.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel attempted to manage context through explicit workflow scripts, file-based specs, and child briefs, including a preserved help-layout reference for the relaunch.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept the evolving interface decisions locally while writing modules and then fixed import/export drift within the same trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel context was mostly trapped in workflow probes and scratch references; serial did not require cross-agent handoffs for module contracts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel generated only scratch verifier/reference files during probing, removed them, relaunched, and never produced the required test3.mjs artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote test3.mjs and a multi-module whoosh/argparse support tree in /output, then refined it after a read-before-edit issue.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial completed a concrete implementation path; parallel ended before implementation and artifact copy found no files.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had one useful help-layout child result, but other required probe results were retried or interrupted; the first workflow was stopped and v2 was killed before aggregate return.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial consumed each local command result immediately, wrote files, reran checks, and reached a final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel did not complete the child-result lifecycle needed to reach implementation and finalization; serial had no child-result lifecycle and kept results in the parent context.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote and then removed scratch files from /output, preserving only /tmp reference material outside the delivered artifact, so final artifact validation copied no files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial integrated all modules under /output and the official artifact validation lists test3.mjs plus library modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial left an integrated artifact tree; parallel left the artifact tree empty despite earlier scratch work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified help-layout behavior inside a child and planned adversarial verification, but never reached integrated verification of a delivered port.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran differential checks, byte diffs, library internal checks, import audits, and syntax checks before finalizing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had whole-tree acceptance evidence for a real artifact; parallel had isolated probe evidence only and no integrated acceptance pass.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel spent the full cell budget, timed out, and had no final response or artifact files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed normally with remaining budget, delivered a final response, and achieved a high partial evaluator score.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The practical divergence is closure: parallel never packaged output, while serial closed with a coherent artifact despite not satisfying every official testcase.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official pass/fail relation is both_fail because both current completed evaluations have solution_passed false. The concrete task-solving difference is nevertheless large: parallel produced no artifact after stalled retry loops and a final blind wait, scoring 0/171, whereas serial produced a full hierarchical .mjs port and verification evidence, scoring 150/171 but not enough for official success.
parallel_contributors: Checkpoint-free repeated probe retries consumed most of the parallel budget before implementation began.
The v2 parent wait carried the run into timeout without retrieving progress or packaging output.
Artifact validation found no delivered files, so the evaluator had nothing useful to run.
serial_contributors: Single-actor ownership let the run move from probing directly to writing all required files.
The serial actor ran differential, byte, import, syntax, and library checks before finalizing.
The official artifact copy contained test3.mjs and the library hierarchy.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial still missed 21 of 171 official samples, likely due residual fidelity gaps beyond the observed happy-path and library spot checks.
Parallel had no delivered implementation, so its failures are not ordinary coding defects in final source.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: Both official outcomes fail, so the retained patterns explain the parallel delivery and score disadvantage rather than a pass/fail discordance.

The first workflow repeatedly restarted stalled probe children with the same cache keys instead of handing the replacement a usable checkpoint or reducing scope. The parent later diagnosed the loop, stopped the workflow, and restarted from salvaged scratch material, which consumed most of the run budget before any deliverable module tree existed.
candidates.realized_consequence: The first workflow burned roughly twenty-three minutes in repeated probe restarts, returned no implementation or integration result, and forced a late relaunch with only scratch reference material preserved.
candidates.near_match_reason: The budget loss was real, but the directly evidenced coordination boundary is unchanged stalled retries of the same probe work rather than excessive independent breadth by itself.
